integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium shot frames Eli, a teenage herdsman, standing firm on a bright open plain bathed in rich amber light, clutching a leather sling in one hand and several rounded pebbles in the other, his posture calm but resolute. The camera gradually pulls out at slow speed, widening the frame to reveal in the distance a massive warrior towering over the field — a giant in layered bronze armor glinting in the amber sun, a long blade at his side and a javelin in hand, the scale contrast filling the frame with tension. [Shot 2] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a wide view as Eli whirls the sling in a clean circular motion, building speed; one pebble releases and cuts across the air in slow motion, catching the light as it streaks toward the giant and strikes him squarely between the brows. The armored giant reels backward, staggers, then crashes onto the earth with a deafening impact, dust erupting around his fallen body. [Shot 3] At 00:11.500, the shot cuts to a steady wide frame of the dry, dusty battleground, now still; a faint breeze stirs the dust while the far-off whispers of the waiting troops drift across the silence, the warm amber grading holding to the end.

overall_soundscape: A faint breeze moves across the dry plain, stirring loose dust. The sling whirs in fast circles, the pebble hisses through the air in slowed flight, and the warrior's fall lands with a thunderous, ground-shaking crash. Afterward, distant murmuring troops whisper far off across the still battleground.

non_diegetic_music: Low sustained strings at a slow tempo build with sparse percussion as the sling spins, swell at the moment of impact, then thin out to a single warm, uplifting sustained chord over the final stillness.
